docs.legacy_dam_token:
The legacy DAM-family prefix face (the JTC1 ballot spelling): the
stage token precedes the base designation — "IEC/FDAM 60038-1",
"ISO/IEC PDAM 12207", "ISO/IEC PDAM 2 10646:2012",
"ISO/IEC FPDAM 9075/1", "ISO/IEC FDAM 1 14496-12:2004". A number
between the token and the designation is the SUPPLEMENT number; the
designation is the base's and is kept whole (the owner's 2026-11-12
ruling, reversing #693: unnumbered DAM/PDAM/FDAM/FPDAM means
Amendment 1, and the old slash-part spelling "9075/1" carries the
base's part). The date rides with the designation — old notation
prints the base's year, and the draft supplement carries none of
its own. Longest tokens first: FPDAM before PDAM, FDAM before DAM.
The slash-part alternative precedes the dash-part one: the
number_with_part body also matches a bare "9075" (its part terms
are optional), so a slash-part input must be claimed first or the
"/1" would dangle unclaimed.

source:
# Port of lib/pubid/iec/parser.rb. Deviations:
# - joint_identifier (IEC x | ISO y) awaits PG cross-file imports; the
#   ISO joint grammar cannot be inlined at reasonable size. Noted here;
#   slots back into the root ahead of identifier_copublishers.
# - the IEV → "IEC 60050" input shorthand is pre-parse normalization and
#   stays binder-side.
# - Supplement layers capture into position-scoped names (supp_* on the
#   first supplement, supp2_* on the second): the base's and the
#   supplements' second_parts carry the same shapes, and captures are
#   collected globally by name, so shared names would collapse the
#   supplement's number/date onto the base's.

grammar PubidIec version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  letter = upper / lower
  alnum_char = upper / lower / digit
  word_ext_char = alnum_char / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C
  space = " "
  dash = "-" / "‑" / "‐"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"
  comma = ","
  century = "19" / "20"
  year_digits = century 2*digit !digit
  month_digits = 2*digit
  day_digits = 2*digit
  digits = 1*digit

  ## IEC publishers, longest-first: the qualified forms must precede
  ## the bare "IEC".
  # CEI is IEC's French spelling (pubid#488): French-language IEC
  # documents print "CEI ..." identifiers; it parses as the IEC publisher.
  prefix_sole_publisher = {
    (
      "IECQ OD" / "IECQ CS" / "IEC CAB" / "IEC CA" / "IECRE"
      / "CISPR" / "IECEE" / "IECEx" / "IECQ" / "IEC" / "ISO" / "CEI"
    ) as publisher
  }
  organization = {
    "IEC" / "ISO" / "IEEE" / "CIW" / "SAE" / "CIE" / "ASME" / "ASTM"
    / "OECD" / "HL7" / "CEI" / "UNDP"
  }
  copublishers_item = slash [space] organization as copublisher
  copublishers = *copublishers_item
  prefix_with_copublishers = prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers]

  tc_type = "JTC" / "JPC" / "TC" / "SC" / "PC"
  sc_body = "SC" space digits [*upper]
  technical_group_with_publisher = {
    prefix_sole_publisher [copublishers] space
    (
      (
        "CISPR" / ("CIS" slash upper)
        / (tc_type space (1*digit) [*upper])
      ) as technical_committee
      [
        (
          (slash [space] ("SC" space (1*digit) [*upper]))
          as subcommittee
        )
      ]
    )
  }
  technical_group_bare = {
    (
      (
        "CISPR" / ("CIS" slash upper)
        / (tc_type space (1*digit) [*upper])
      ) as technical_committee
      [
        (
          (slash [space] ("SC" space (1*digit) [*upper]))
          as subcommittee
        )
      ]
    )
  }
  technical_group = technical_group_with_publisher / technical_group_bare

  wp_type = (("TR" / "TS" / "SRD") space) as wp_type
  wp_number = {
    (
      (
        (1*(upper / lower))
        (*(upper / lower / digit))
        [(dash 1*digit)]
      ) as number_with_part
    ) / number_with_part
  }
  working_programme = {
    ("PWI" / "PNW") as wp_stage
    space [wp_type] wp_number [(space edition)]
  }

  working_document = {
    (
      ( "JTC1-SC" 1*digit )
      / ( 1*upper slash 1*upper )
      / 1*(upper / lower / digit)
    ) as technical_committee
    slash
    ( 1*(upper / lower / digit) ) as wd_number
    [ ( "(" upper as wd_language ")" ) ]
    [ ( slash (1*upper) as wd_stage ) ]
  }

  number = {
    (
      ("DIR" *(space 1*upper_digit))
      / "VIM"
      / "SYMBOL"
      / (1*6digit "v" 1*digit *letter [("_" 1*letter)])
      / (2*4upper [(dash 1*digit)] *upper_digit)
      / (1*6digit [*1letter [("_" 1*letter)]])
    )
  }
  upper_digit = upper / digit
  part_and_subpart = {
    (dash / comma) [space]
    1*word_ext_char
    *((dash / comma) 1*word_ext_char)
  }
  # number and part_and_subpart are inlined fully to raw terms at every
  # capture site: a capture wrapping a bare rule ref expands to a list
  # of element hashes, while the inlined body binds as one scalar
  # string.
  number_with_part = {
    (
      (
        ("DIR" *(space 1*(upper / digit)))
        / "VIM"
        / "SYMBOL"
        / ( 1*6digit "v" 1*digit *(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))] )
        / ( 2*4upper [(dash 1*digit)] *(upper / digit) )
        / ( 1*6digit [*1(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))]] )
      )
      [
        (
          (dash / comma) [space]
          1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C)
          *( (dash / comma) 1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C) )
        )
      ]
    ) as number_with_part
  }
  trf_org_number = ("CISPR" space) as trf_org number_with_part
  stage_iteration = dot digit as stage_iteration

  undated = "--" / "—"
  # year_digits is inlined ("19" / "20" 2*digit !digit) at every capture
  # site for the same expansion reason as number_with_part.
  full_date = {
    (
      ("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit
      [(dash 2*digit)]
      [(dash 2*digit)]
    ) as date
  }
  date_body = undated as undated_marker / full_date
  date = (colon / dash) date_body

  vap_code = "CSV" / "CMV" / "RLV" / "SER" / "EXV" / "PAC" / "PRV"
  vap_suffix = {
    space
    (
      ( 1*( ( vap_code ) ( *( dash ( vap_code ) ) ) ) as vap_suffix )
    )
  }
  database_suffix = space "DB" as database
  consolidated_supplement = {
    "+"
    ("AMD" / "COR") as supplement_type
    (
      # Refs adjacent to a capture must be parenthesized: a bare ref's
      # named node makes the neighbouring capture drop from the tree.
      ( (1*digit) as supplement_number (colon) ( ("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit ) as supplement_year )
      / ( (1*digit) as supplement_number )
    )
  }
  consolidated_supplements = 1*consolidated_supplement
  second_part = {
    (trf_org_number / number_with_part)
    [stage_iteration]
    [[space] date]
    [consolidated_supplements]
    [vap_suffix / database_suffix]
  }

  edition_str = "Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed"
  edition = edition_str [space] (1*digit [(dot 1*digit)]) as edition

  # Supplement-side second_part: same shapes as second_part, captured
  # under supp_* names so the supplement's number/date/edition never
  # collapse onto the base's.
  supplement_second_part = {
    (
      trf_org_number
      / (
        (
          (
            ("DIR" *(space 1*(upper / digit)))
            / "VIM"
            / "SYMBOL"
            / ( 1*6digit "v" 1*digit *(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))] )
            / ( 2*4upper [(dash 1*digit)] *(upper / digit) )
            / ( 1*6digit [*1(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))]] )
          )
          [
            (
              (dash / comma) [space]
              1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C)
              *( (dash / comma) 1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C) )
            )
          ]
        ) as supp_number_with_part
      )
    )
    [ dot digit as supp_stage_iteration ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) (
          (
            ("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit
            [(dash 2*digit)]
            [(dash 2*digit)]
          ) as supp_date
          / "--" as supp_undated_marker
          / "—" as supp_undated_marker
        )
      )
    ]
    [consolidated_supplements]
    [vap_suffix / database_suffix]
  }

  supp_edition_str = "Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed"
  supp_edition_rule = supp_edition_str [space] (1*digit [(dot 1*digit)]) as supp_edition

  # Second-supplement layer (/AMD1:2018/COR1:2019): supp2_* names.
  supp2_type_with_stage = {
    (
      alt from_table "iec_typed_stages" column "abbr" / "FRAGC" / "FRAG"
    ) as supp2_type_with_stage
  }
  supplement_second_part2 = {
    (
      trf_org_number
      / (
        (
          (
            ("DIR" *(space 1*(upper / digit)))
            / "VIM"
            / "SYMBOL"
            / ( 1*6digit "v" 1*digit *(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))] )
            / ( 2*4upper [(dash 1*digit)] *(upper / digit) )
            / ( 1*6digit [*1(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))]] )
          )
          [
            (
              (dash / comma) [space]
              1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C)
              *( (dash / comma) 1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C) )
            )
          ]
        ) as supp2_number_with_part
      )
    )
    [ dot digit as supp2_stage_iteration ]
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) (
          (
            ("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit
            [(dash 2*digit)]
            [(dash 2*digit)]
          ) as supp2_date
          / "--" as supp2_undated_marker
          / "—" as supp2_undated_marker
        )
      )
    ]
    [consolidated_supplements]
    [vap_suffix / database_suffix]
  }

  one_of_efards = %x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53
  lower_char = lower
  # The house-style separator is "-" (pubid#491); "," stays accepted.
  languages = {
    (
      *( 1*(lower) [("," / "-")] / (one_of_efards [slash]) )
    ) as languages
  }
  language = "(" languages ")"
  all_parts = "(all parts)" as all_parts
  fragment_notation = {
    slash
    ("FRAGC" / "FRAG") as fragment_type
    (1*digit) as fragment_number
  }
  third_part_edition = [space] [edition]
  third_part = third_part_edition [language] [fragment_notation] [all_parts]
  supplement_third_part_edition = [space] [supp_edition_rule]
  supplement_third_part = {
    supplement_third_part_edition
    [language]
    [fragment_notation]
    [all_parts]
  }
  supplement_third_part2_edition = {
    [space]
    [ ( supp_edition_str [space] (1*digit [(dot 1*digit)]) as supp2_edition ) ]
  }
  supplement_third_part2 = {
    supplement_third_part2_edition
    [language]
    [fragment_notation]
    [all_parts]
  }

  type_with_stage = {
    (
      alt from_table "iec_typed_stages" column "abbr"
    ) as type_with_stage
    [digit as stage_iteration space]
  }
  supplement_type_with_stage = {
    (
      alt from_table "iec_typed_stages" column "abbr" / "FRAGC" / "FRAG"
    ) as supp_type_with_stage
  }

  guide_prefix = "Guide" / "GUIDE"
  identifier_copublishers_no_third = {
    [ ( guide_prefix as type_with_stage_fr space ) ]
    [prefix_with_copublishers]
    [space]
    [slash]
    [type_with_stage]
    [space]
    second_part
    third_part_edition
  }
  identifier_copublishers = identifier_copublishers_no_third third_part

  sheet_notation = {
    (slash)
    (1*digit) as sheet_number
    (colon) ( ("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit ) as sheet_year
  }
  sheet_notation_no_year = slash (1*digit) as sheet_number
  sheet_identifier = {
    identifier_copublishers_no_third
    (sheet_notation / sheet_notation_no_year)
  }
  sheet_supplement_identifier = {
    identifier_copublishers_no_third
    sheet_notation
    slash supplement_type_with_stage
    [space] supplement_second_part
    supplement_third_part
  }
  standalone_supplement = {
    prefix_with_copublishers
    slash supplement_type_with_stage
    space supplement_second_part
    supplement_third_part
  }

  ## The legacy DAM-family prefix face (the JTC1 ballot spelling): the
  ## stage token precedes the base designation — "IEC/FDAM 60038-1",
  ## "ISO/IEC PDAM 12207", "ISO/IEC PDAM 2 10646:2012",
  ## "ISO/IEC FPDAM 9075/1", "ISO/IEC FDAM 1 14496-12:2004". A number
  ## between the token and the designation is the SUPPLEMENT number; the
  ## designation is the base's and is kept whole (the owner's 2026-11-12
  ## ruling, reversing #693: unnumbered DAM/PDAM/FDAM/FPDAM means
  ## Amendment 1, and the old slash-part spelling "9075/1" carries the
  ## base's part). The date rides with the designation — old notation
  ## prints the base's year, and the draft supplement carries none of
  ## its own. Longest tokens first: FPDAM before PDAM, FDAM before DAM.
  ## The slash-part alternative precedes the dash-part one: the
  ## number_with_part body also matches a bare "9075" (its part terms
  ## are optional), so a slash-part input must be claimed first or the
  ## "/1" would dangle unclaimed.
  legacy_dam_token = "FPDAM" / "PDAM" / "FDAM" / "DAM"
  legacy_supplement = {
    prefix_with_copublishers
    [space]
    [slash]
    legacy_dam_token as legacy_stage
    space
    [
      ( 1*digit ) as legacy_supplement_number
      space
    ]
    (
      (
        ( 1*6digit ) as legacy_base_number
        slash
        ( 1*digit ) as legacy_base_part
      )
      / (
        (
          ("DIR" *(space 1*(upper / digit)))
          / "VIM"
          / "SYMBOL"
          / ( 1*6digit "v" 1*digit *(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))] )
          / ( 2*4upper [(dash 1*digit)] *(upper / digit) )
          / ( 1*6digit [*1(upper / lower) [("_" 1*(upper / lower))]] )
        )
        [
          (
            (dash / comma) [space]
            1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C)
            *( (dash / comma) 1*((upper / lower / digit) / %x5F / %x26 / %x2C) )
          )
        ]
      ) as legacy_base_number_with_part
    )
    [
      [space] (
        (colon / dash) (
          (
            ("19" / "20") 2*digit !digit
            [(dash 2*digit)]
            [(dash 2*digit)]
          ) as date
          / "--" as undated_marker
          / "—" as undated_marker
        )
      )
    ]
    third_part
  }
  supplement_identifier_no_third = {
    identifier_copublishers_no_third
    slash supplement_type_with_stage
    [space] supplement_second_part
  }
  supplement_identifier = supplement_identifier_no_third supplement_third_part
  supplement_supplement_identifier = {
    supplement_identifier_no_third
    slash supp2_type_with_stage
    [space] supplement_second_part2
    supplement_third_part2
  }

  identifier = {
      working_programme
    / technical_group
    / working_document
    / legacy_supplement
    / sheet_supplement_identifier
    / sheet_identifier
    / supplement_supplement_identifier
    / standalone_supplement
    / supplement_identifier
    / identifier_copublishers
  }

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    technical_committee -> technical_committee (string)
    subcommittee -> subcommittee (string)
    wd_number -> wd_number (string)
    wd_language -> wd_language (string)
    wd_stage -> wd_stage (string)
    wp_stage -> wp_stage (string)
    wp_type -> wp_type (string)
    number_with_part -> number_with_part (string)
    supp_number_with_part -> supp_number_with_part (string)
    supp2_number_with_part -> supp2_number_with_part (string)
    trf_org -> trf_org (string)
    stage_iteration -> stage_iteration (string)
    supp_stage_iteration -> supp_stage_iteration (string)
    supp2_stage_iteration -> supp2_stage_iteration (string)
    undated_marker -> undated_marker (string)
    supp_undated_marker -> supp_undated_marker (string)
    supp2_undated_marker -> supp2_undated_marker (string)
    date -> date (string)
    supp_date -> supp_date (string)
    supp2_date -> supp2_date (string)
    edition -> edition (string)
    supp_edition -> supp_edition (string)
    supp2_edition -> supp2_edition (string)
    supplement_type -> consolidated_supplements[].supplement_type (string)
    supplement_number -> consolidated_supplements[].supplement_number (string)
    supplement_year -> consolidated_supplements[].supplement_year (string)
    vap_suffix -> vap_suffix (string)
    database -> database (string)
    type_with_stage -> type_with_stage (string)
    legacy_stage -> legacy_stage (string)
    legacy_supplement_number -> legacy_supplement_number (string)
    legacy_base_number_with_part -> legacy_base_number_with_part (string)
    legacy_base_number -> legacy_base_number (string)
    legacy_base_part -> legacy_base_part (string)
    supp_type_with_stage -> supp_type_with_stage (string)
    supp2_type_with_stage -> supp2_type_with_stage (string)
    type_with_stage_fr -> type_with_stage_fr (string)
    fragment_type -> fragment_type (string)
    fragment_number -> fragment_number (string)
    sheet_number -> sheet_number (string)
    sheet_year -> sheet_year (string)
    all_parts -> all_parts (string)
    languages -> languages (string)
    copublisher -> copublishers[].copublisher (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "IEC 60050"
    accept "IEC 8601-1:2019"
    accept "CISPR 16-1-1"
    accept "IECQ OD 1234"
    accept "IEC/TS 80000-1"
    accept "IEC/FDAM 60038-1"
    accept "IEC FDAM 60038-1"
